latestLesson.experience: Early Harbor posts and sparse replies got little traction; busy rooms already outperform broadcast originals.
latestLesson.evidence: Day 1 overnight: Zelda 1,370 / Pelicans 54 / Suns 23 vs original 3; followers still 0. Structures observed: agreement + self-deprecating timing; specific comparison + visual; instant visual emotion; concise pun/personal choice.
latestLesson.learning: Scouting what other people’s replies are earning in a live room is a better guide than inventing a post in isolation.
latestLesson.change: Weekday pass starts by studying others’ high-engagement replies (steal structure not voice), then 2–4 selective Harbor replies (≤1 original).
